home.title: 2026 RoboRacer G-NEX CHAMPIONSHIP
home.introQuote: “Where ideas meet technology, a new speed begins.”
home.introBody: An autonomous car racing competition by the Inje University ANCHOR Project Group, open to university teams with a vehicle platform that meets the 1/10-scale autonomous racing rules.
home.qualifyingBody: Each team drives alone on the track for 6 minutes. The run has three parts: driving on a clear track, avoiding obstacles, and setting the fastest lap. Teams that finish without any human intervention rank higher.
home.bracketBody: Two teams start on the same track at the same time, and the first to complete 10 laps while avoiding obstacles wins. Every match is a single race except the final, which is best of three.
home.prizesNote: Prizes may change depending on the size of the competition.

monitor.title: Monitoring control
monitor.needKey: Open this page with the monitoring link from the organizers (the address ending in ?pw=…), or sign in with a staff account first.
monitor.keyInvalid: The monitoring link isn't valid. It may have changed; ask the organizers for the new link.
monitor.rateLimited: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in about 10 minutes.

lead.live: Changes the status line at the top of the public live page right away. Choosing the current match marks it 'Live' in the public bracket.
lead.mapping: Press 'Draw random order' to set the mapping order of the teams at random; it shows on the public 'Mapping' tab right away. When a team's turn comes press 'Put on track' (the stage becomes 'Mapping' and the status bar shows the team), and press 'Mapping done' when it finishes.
lead.practice: Teams that finished vehicle inspection choose a group in inspection order (3 teams each in A and B, 4 in C). Press the group the team chose and it shows on the public 'Practice' tab right away. For a team not inspected yet, press 'Inspection done' first.
lead.qualifying: The team on track is selected automatically. Press 'Valid lap' or 'Invalid lap' after every lap. Q1 and Q2 move on after 3 valid laps in a row, and valid Q3 laps need a lap time. Saved laps appear on the public leaderboard right away.
lead.results: Pick the ranks for each match and finish it. The next match's slots fill in automatically. The bracket layout (rounds, matches, slots) is changed in the admin pages.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.lead: The qualifying order is calculated by the rules (the public leaderboard order). Fill the list from it, adjust if needed, save, and use the saved ranking to seed the finals.
ranking.emptyRanked: No team is ranked yet. Add teams from the right.
ranking.waitingAdded: Added {{count}} team(s) with no laps ({{teams}}) at the bottom in car inspection order. Under rule 4.7 they count as 0 Q1 laps. If a team did not run and will not race in the finals, press 'Remove' before saving.
ranking.fromQualifyingHint: Fills the list with the qualifying order calculated by the rules. You can still reorder it, and nothing changes until you save.
ranking.stale: Another staff member saved the ranking or a team was deactivated in the meantime. Saving now overwrites that change.
ranking.gapped: A team left the ranking. Save the ranking once more so the seeds match what you see.

seed.title: Fill finals seeds
seed.description: Puts the team ranked N into each 'Qualifying #N' slot of the finals bracket. Press again after changing the ranking to refill. Once any finals match is finished, the seeds cannot be filled again (leave a withdrawn team's slot empty and its opponent advances by walkover). Slots whose rank has no team stay empty and count as byes.
seed.emptyRanking: No ranking is saved yet. Set and save the ranking first.

mapping.title: Mapping order
mapping.reshuffleBody: The {{count}} teams that finished mapping stay at the front in their current order, and only the rest are shuffled again. The public order changes right away.
mapping.empty: No order has been drawn yet.
mapping.missing: {{count}} teams are not in the order: {{teams}}. Press 'Shuffle again' to add them.
mapping.resetBody: This clears the mapping order ({{total}} teams) and the done marks ({{count}} teams), back to before the order was drawn. The public 'Mapping' tab changes right away and this cannot be undone. The current stage and the team on track stay as they are.
mapping.frozen: The mapping order is frozen and is now the qualifying order. It can no longer be shuffled or changed.

qualifyingOrder.title: Qualifying order
qualifyingOrder.lead: Drag rows or use ↑ ↓ to change the order, then press 'Save qualifying order'. The public qualifying leaderboard (teams without records yet) and the team list above follow this order. The mapping order is not changed.
qualifyingOrder.stale: The qualifying order was changed elsewhere or a team withdrew in the meantime. Saving now will overwrite that change.

preview.label: Preview notice

preview.needAdmin: Sign in as an admin to see the preview. This is what the public site shows.

preview.published: Published. It shows on the public site now.
preview.confirmBody: What you see in the preview goes live on the public site right away, including for visitors who are viewing it now.
